bio: Dylan Hogan, performing as Major Trouble, is a Reno, Nevada-based tech house DJ/producer and a longtime figure in the Burning Man community. He founded the BRC Snow Club (Black Rock City's first ski, sled and snowboard hill) with Rachael Gingery in 2023, serves as resident DJ for the Disco Donutz project on the Heavy Petting Zoo art car, and has previously held board positions with Airpusher and Sextant Camp.
notable_collaborations: Performed alongside James Hype, ESSEL, Tita Lau, Marten Hørger, Camelphat, Croatia Squad, R3wire, Justin Martin, and The Sponges
burning_man_history: Founder of BRC Snow Club (2023); resident DJ for Disco Donutz on the Heavy Petting Zoo art car; former board member of Airpusher and Sextant Camp; performs multiple sets annually on the playa

bio: Rameff is a French DJ and producer based in Mexico, working across melodic/progressive house and related deep, tech, and Afro house styles. He has appeared on Beatport and Traxsource compilations including "Nothing But... Organic House Explorations, Vol. 04" and "Laidback Grooves 018."
notable_releases: Nothing But... Organic House Explorations, Vol. 04 (compilation appearance); Laidback Grooves 018 (compilation appearance)

bio: Lovecraft is a producer, DJ, and studio engineer who began playing guitar at age nine and holds a degree in Music Synthesis from Berklee College of Music in Boston. His remix of an Art Department track reached the Top 10 of Beatport's Deep House chart on the No.19 Music label.
notable_releases: Art Department Remix (No.19 Music) — Top 10 Beatport Deep House chart
burning_man_history: Performed for Mayan Warrior art car at Burning Man 2022 and played a live set for Mayan Warrior at Burning Man 2024, per Mayan Warrior's official SoundCloud uploads ("Lovecraft - Mayan Warrior Burning Man 2022" and "Lovecraft Live - Mayan Warrior Burning Man 2024")

bio: Jo.Ke (Jonas) is an electronic/singer-songwriter artist who emerged from Berlin's Bar25 scene and co-founded the collective Feathered Sun in 2013 with Nu and Raz Ohara (based between Berlin and Lima, Peru). His breakthrough track "Who Loves the Sun" came out via Bar25, and he has released EPs via Platon Records, Circus Company, Laut & Luise, and Denature Records. He has since relocated from Berlin to Bali.
notable_releases: Who Loves the Sun (Bar25); Fool (White Label); upcoming debut singer-songwriter album Same Sad Old Songs (S.S.O.S)
labels: Bar25; Platon Records; Circus Company; Laut & Luise; Denature Records
notable_collaborations: Feathered Sun (with Nu and Raz Ohara); M.A.N.D.Y.; Chambord ("Quiet Times"); Ulises ("Gerne Alleine", "Wave"); Roderic ("Cuidame"); Billy Mendrix (producer/guitarist on S.S.O.S)
burning_man_history: Attended Burning Man for the first time in 2022, described in a 2022 Electronic Groove interview as "an incredible experience and world, full of synchronicities, magic, and madness" — personal attendance account, not confirmed as a booked performer

bio: Ogan is a San Francisco-based DJ, producer, and live electronic artist with over two decades of experience, working across techno, melodic techno, tech house, progressive house, and minimal.

Tonic Walter is a German electronic music duo — Maximilian Nestmann and Marcel Vckov — who met in elementary school in Altenstadt, Bavaria and later worked in Munich and Berlin before returning to their hometown. They shifted into melodic house in 2022, breaking through with the single "Stay There," and have since amassed over 148 million streams and sold out headline shows in London, Munich, Berlin, Zurich, Hamburg, Paris, Cologne, and Stuttgart.

LP Giobbi (born Leah Chisholm, August 19, 1987) grew up in Eugene, Oregon and studied classical jazz piano at UC Berkeley. After touring as an opener for Sofi Tukker, she co-founded the label Animal Talk (2018) with Sofi Tukker and hermixalot, released her debut album "Light Places" (2023) on Counter Records, and launched her own label Yes Yes Yes under Defected Records (2023). She also created "Garcia (Remixed)" (2023), reworking Jerry Garcia's 1972 solo album, remixed Taylor Swift's "Cruel Summer" (2023), co-founded the nonprofit Femme House (2019) supporting women, gender-expansive, BIPOC, and LGBTQIA+ producers, and won DJ Mag's Best Producer award in 2023.
notable_releases: Light Places (2023 album, Counter Records); Garcia (Remixed) (2023); "Cruel Summer" remix (2023)
labels: Animal Talk (co-founder); Yes Yes Yes (under Defected Records); Counter Records
burning_man_history: Performed at The Fluffy Cloud sound camp at Burning Man 2023 alongside Diplo, Darin Epsilon, Moblack, and Rinzen; expected to return to The Fluffy Cloud for 2024

bio: DUGAN is a Denver-based DJ blending house, nu-disco, and techno, and a regular performer at Denver venues including Temple Denver, Beta Nightclub, Club Vinyl, Bar Standard, Tracks Denver, X Bar, and The Triangle. He is a member of the collectives TheHundred, 128 Productions, Denver House Music, and Bad Asstronauts.
burning_man_history: Festival/event appearance history listed by Denver House Music includes Burning Man, alongside Holy Ship, Decadence Colorado, Global Dance Festival, Supernatural Festival, Sensory Illumination, Element 11, Apogaea, and Denver Pridefest

bio: Vozhd' is the Ukrainian founder and leader of Kurenivka, Ukraine's Burning Man theme camp, and has been DJing since 2000, starting at a seaside resort in the Donetsk region. Known for an eclectic "vinaigrette-style" mixing approach spanning genres, he performs publicly only 2-3 times a year, with sets highly anticipated at Kurenivka's events.
burning_man_history: Founder/leader of Kurenivka, Ukraine's official Burning Man theme camp (founded 2017); performs at Kurenivka's Burning Man events; released "Multiverse," a mix made for the virtual Burning Man event

bio: D1 (Ivan Alexeev, aka Ivan De One) is an Odesa, Ukraine-based DJ with over 20 years in the local music scene, known for blending Balearic, downtempo, house, and nu-disco. He promoted the Agharti club on Odesa Beach and founded the Fiesta festival, where he remains a regular performer.
burning_man_history: Performed a back-to-back set with Mamay at Kurenivka Camp during Burning Man 2023

bio: Mamay is a Kyiv-based DJ, vinyl collector, and sound producer who serves as resident DJ and co-founder of Kurenivka, the Ukrainian Burning Man theme camp, as well as of Tivi Bar in Georgia. His sets span house, techno, minimal deep tech, downtempo, disco, italo, soul, funk, jazz, and ethnic influences drawing on Detroit and Chicago textures. He has held residencies at clubs including Kureni, L8 Park, Tivi Bar, Boom Boom Room, Mantra Club, and The LAB, and performed at OSTROV Festival, Atlas Weekend, and Hedonism Festival, plus dates in Ibiza, Georgia, and Thailand.
notable_collaborations: D1 (back-to-back set at Kurenivka Camp, Burning Man 2023)
burning_man_history: Co-founder and resident DJ of Kurenivka, Ukraine's official Burning Man theme camp; played a back-to-back set with D1 at Kurenivka Camp during Burning Man 2023

bio: Ro Rousseau is a Ukrainian-born DJ, producer, and event promoter who has planted roots in Los Angeles, with active ties to the Miami scene (hosting a birthday celebration event at Do Not Sit On The Furniture in Miami Beach).

Loboman (Eduardo Manilla) was born and raised in Ensenada, Baja California, Mexico, studied architecture in Mexicali with a year abroad in Mallorca, and later moved to Venice, California to work at an architecture firm. His brother "MASSIO" introduced him to DJing in 2010. He attended Burning Man for the first time around 2012, an experience that inspired him to co-found the Genius Loci surf/music/yoga festival on Mexico's Punta Cabras Peninsula that same year. He has served as Community Officer and Arts Committee Chair for the Venice Neighborhood Council since 2012.
burning_man_history: Attended Burning Man circa 2012, an experience that directly inspired him to co-found the Genius Loci Festival; has posted Burning Man-labeled SoundCloud sets from 2017 ("burningman2017") and 2024 ("bm24")

bio: The Professor (Neil Kelly) is a jazz musician with 25 years of experience and a degree in jazz studies, who co-founded the Playa Jazz Cafe at Burning Man in 2002 with Terrell Tomlin and Patrick North; the camp was placed in Center Camp starting in 2003. He has run the venue as musical coordinator for over two decades, leading jazz history/theory workshops, hosting the Saturday "Mingus & Mimosas" concert, and organizing nightly jam sessions. His nickname came from fellow musicians who observed his teaching style.
notable_collaborations: Terrell Tomlin; Patrick North (Playa Jazz Cafe co-founders)
burning_man_history: Co-founded Playa Jazz Cafe at Burning Man in 2002; camp placed in Center Camp starting 2003; has run it as musical coordinator for 20+ years

bio: Dr. Cindiana Jones is a longtime Fort Bragg, California radio DJ who hosts "Music Is Medicine" and formerly "What It Is!" on KMUD Garberville (91.1 FM, simulcast on KMUE Eureka, KLAI Laytonville, and in Shelter Cove), and also hosts a show on ShoutingFire, an independent broadcasting collective described as "born on the playa and inspired by Burning Man."
